why: The sentinel arms only while a body touches `anchor/plinth`'s own cell, and its blow lands on that same cell. This edit widens the landing box to the 3 x 3 round the plinth while the arming region stays one cell, so the box catches a body from a ring of cells a body can stand in without ever arming the statue: a player who never walked up to it is struck by a blow that was never wound up for them. It declares no unit: the landing box and the arming region are both bound by the primary, and what the engine refuses is a landing that reaches past the arming region's keep-out (shape 1 of the strike rule). The remedy is to shrink the landing box inside `while_in` or widen `while_in` over it.
